create_voice_agent.description: Create a Retell AI voice agent from a voice and an existing Response Engine. The Response Engine (a Retell LLM, a conversation flow, or your own custom LLM) must already exist.
create_voice_agent.display_str_template: Create the Retell AI voice agent '{3}'.
create_voice_agent.name: create_voice_agent

parameters.description: ID of the voice the agent speaks with, for example retell-Cimo. Browse and preview voices in the Retell dashboard.
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.description: What kind of Response Engine drives the agent's replies. Defaults to retell-llm.
parameters.name: response_engine_type

parameters.description: ID of the Response Engine you already created, matching the type above: a Retell LLM ID such as llm_234sdertfsdsfsdf, a conversation flow ID, or your custom LLM's websocket URL such as wss://example.com/llm. Not the type name -- create the Response Engine in the Retell dashboard first and paste its ID here.
parameters.name: response_engine_id

parameters.description: Optional. A name for your own reference, for example 'Appointment reminders'.
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.description: Optional. The locale the agent operates in, which also tunes speech recognition. Defaults to en-US. Use 'multi' for multilingual agents.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Optional. How fast the agent speaks, from 0.5 (slower) to 2.0 (faster). Leave blank to use Retell's default of 1.0.
parameters.name: voice_speed

agent_id.description: Agent ID. Use with Get voice agent, or to place calls with this agent from the Retell dashboard.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent, blank if it was created without one

is_published.description: Whether this version of the agent is published

language.description: Locale the agent operates in, for example en-US. Multi-locale agents list every locale, comma separated.

last_modified_time.description: When the agent was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

response_engine_id.description: The Retell LLM ID, conversation flow ID, or custom LLM websocket URL driving the agent, matching the type above

version.description: Version of the agent this record describes

get_voice_agent.description: Fetch one Retell AI voice agent's configuration: its voice, language, Response Engine, and version.
get_voice_agent.display_str_template: Get the Retell AI voice agent '{0}'.
get_voice_agent.name: get_voice_agent

parameters.description: The agent's ID, as returned by Create voice agent or List voice agents.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: Optional. Which version to read: a version number, an environment tag such as prod, or latest_published. Leave blank for the newest version.
parameters.name: version

agent_id.description: Agent ID. Use with Get voice agent, or to place calls with this agent from the Retell dashboard.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent, blank if it was created without one

is_published.description: Whether this version of the agent is published

language.description: Locale the agent operates in, for example en-US. Multi-locale agents list every locale, comma separated.

last_modified_time.description: When the agent was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

response_engine_id.description: The Retell LLM ID, conversation flow ID, or custom LLM websocket URL driving the agent, matching the type above

version.description: Version of the agent this record describes

voice_model.description: Voice model behind the voice, blank when the provider's default applies

voice_speed.description: Speech rate from 0.5 to 2; 1 when the agent uses Retell's default

webhook_url.description: Agent-level webhook for call events, blank when the account webhook applies

list_voice_agents.description: List the voice agents on your Retell AI account, most recently modified first. Chat agents are left out.
list_voice_agents.name: list_voice_agents

parameters.description: Optional. Only include agents whose name or ID contains this text. Leave blank for every voice agent.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The most agents to return, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. Pass the 'pagination_key' from a previous run to fetch the next page of agents.
parameters.name: pagination_key

agents.description: Voice agents on this page, most recently modified first

agent_id.description: Agent ID. Use with Get voice agent for the full record.

last_modified_time.description: When the agent was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

has_more.description: Whether another page of agents is available

pagination_key.description: Cursor for the next page, or empty when there are no more agents

description: Create, look up, and list the Retell AI voice agents that answer and place your calls.
